title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
@cursor Part 4 of 5 for issue #4: Incremental DOM mutations.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #4, then do ONLY Part 4.

Work test-first. This part's deliverable is itself a test, so: first a test commit `test(recorder): add rebuild equivalence test (#4)` with the key equivalence test and a `rebuild(events)` stub that throws `new Error("not implemented")`, then the commit below that implements the helper.

Prompt: Create a test-only helper `rebuild(events)` in `packages/recorder/test-utils/` that applies a snapshot plus mutations to an empty document.

Requirements:
- Helper is not exported from the package
- Key test: live DOM equals rebuilt DOM after a scripted scenario

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass

Implementation commit message: `test(recorder): add rebuild helper and equivalence test (#4)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.

Notes:
- Apply the four lists in the order from ADR 0023: removes, adds (at `parentId` before `nextId`), attributes, texts.
